Chief Complaint: Diabetes follow-up.
HPI: 58-year-old with type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications. Takes metformin 1000 mg twice daily. No hypoglycemic episodes.
Assessment: Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications, stable on metformin.
Plan: Continue metformin. Recheck A1c in 3 months.
